sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Alien Pink are straightforward yet challenging. One of the key mechanics in the game is the use of power-ups, which can be collected by colliding with them. These power-ups come in various forms, such as speed boosts, shields, and score multipliers. Players must carefully time their power-ups to maximize their effectiveness and stay ahead of the competition.

The game also features a unique mechanic known as the 'gravitational pull,' which can be used to attract or repel obstacles and enemies. This mechanic can be used to avoid obstacles, trap enemies, or even create new paths to collect power-ups. Mastering the gravitational pull requires a combination of timing and accuracy, making it a key skill to develop in order to succeed in the game.

In addition to the power-ups and gravitational pull, the game also features a variety of obstacles and enemies that must be avoided. Players must carefully time their movements to avoid these obstacles and enemies, while also collecting power-ups to boost their speed and score.
